summary: Focused pre-auth-only TNS-listener module (498 LOC). Speaks TNS wire directly (no oracledb): CONNECT + (COMMAND=version) then (COMMAND=services) + (COMMAND=status) on fresh sockets, plus REDIRECT-payload parse for SCAN/RAC internal endpoints. Extracts SIDs/SERVICE_NAMEs/INSTANCE_NAMEs/machine hostname, banner version, and offline CVE map (TNS Poison / o5logon). No authenticated path implemented at all — no SID/password brute (odat handoff), no o5logon hash grab, no post-auth OS command exec, no CVE-2012-1675 poison verify. Biggest gap: an entire authenticated tranche missing — recce hands off to odat/sqlplus rather than speaking TNS auth itself.

findings.tier_evidence: TNS CONNECT reply parsed for known packet-type byte (ACCEPT/REFUSE/RESEND/DATA) OR 'TNS'/'ORACLE' string in reply — deterministic protocol-level fingerprint. Not exploit evidence; just proves listener is exposed.
findings.promotion_notes: Add native SID password guesser: for each enumerated SID, drive an authentic TNS AUTH sequence with the small default-account list (sys/change_on_install, system/manager, dbsnmp/dbsnmp, scott/tiger) and land 0-tier auth — proves cred vs enumerates.
findings.tester_next_step: odat all -s <ip> -p <port>; odat sidguesser -s <ip> -p <port>; odat passwordguesser -s <ip> -p <port> -d <SID> --accounts-file default.txt; sqlplus scott/tiger@<ip>:<port>/<SID>.

findings.tier_evidence: _VER_RE parsed a 'Version N.N.N.N' string out of the TNS reply — proof the unhardened listener answered version to an unauthenticated status request.
findings.promotion_notes: Already deterministic; only promotion is to feed the version into the CVE map (already done via known_cves).
findings.tester_next_step: tnscmd10g version -h <ip> -p <port> — confirm; then apply CVE-map findings.

findings.tier_evidence: (COMMAND=services)/(COMMAND=status) reply parsed and SIDs/SERVICE_NAMEs/INSTANCE_NAMEs/machine returned — deterministic evidence the listener answered admin queries without local-OS-auth.
findings.promotion_notes: For each enumerated SID, natively perform the o5logon pre-auth AUTH_SESSKEY exchange (CVE-2012-3137) and return the crackable hash. That is a T2 capture of credential material without authenticating.
findings.tester_next_step: For each SID, python3 pre-auth-oracle-hash-grab.py -s <ip> -p <port> -d <SID> -u SYS -o hashes.txt; then hashcat -m 3100 hashes.txt rockyou.txt (JtR: oracle11 format).

findings.tier_evidence: Version-tuple predicate match against _CVE_MAP — banner assertion only, no exploit verify (recce's own comment: 'candidate flag').
findings.promotion_notes: For CVE-2012-1675 (TNS Poison), send a COMMAND=service_register from a rogue socket and observe whether the listener adds the fake instance to its registry — the primitive is deterministic and non-destructive on a lab listener (but hostile to prod client sessions).
findings.tester_next_step: For CVE-2012-1675: msf auxiliary/admin/oracle/tnspoison_checker RHOST=<ip>; for CVE-2012-3137: native o5logon-grab per oracle_listener_status_leak.

findings.title_pattern: Oracle SCAN/RAC redirect leaks internal endpoint
findings.tier_evidence: _parse_redirect matched packet type 5 REDIRECT AND HOST= regex — deterministic evidence the SCAN listener disclosed an internal cluster node.
findings.promotion_notes: Feed the disclosed HOST/PORT into recce's target set and re-run oracle.probe against it — could turn discovery into cluster-wide enumeration, no promotion of this finding itself needed.
findings.tester_next_step: tnscmd10g services -h <ip> -p <port>; then oracle probe against the disclosed internal HOST:PORT — repeat until you find the true instance host.
